getName()/evaluate(): call this.i18nService.getTranslation(...) to build localized messages. This is borderline presentation work, handed off to an injected service.
getConfiguration(): returns threshold metadata including step 0.01 and unit '%'. This is borderline UI metadata that describes the rule.
